messages.subject: Error in [: (subscript) logical subscript too long
parts:
Hello everyone,

I uploaded a raster from Soilgrids to wallace (.tif), but when I run the model in wallace using Maxent, I get the following warning and the screen freeze:

50%Warning: Error in [: (subscript) logical subscript too long
2: shiny::runApp
1: run_wallace

I´m wondering if someone can help me to solve this issue. Thank you!
